label: No placebo
rationale: This is an open-label, non-randomized study with two dose cohorts of fasudil only, so there is no placebo comparator described. The protocol instead compares treatment periods and historical data, and Cohort 1 includes a pre-treatment lead-in rather than placebo exposure.
title: Rho Kinase Inhibitor in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (REAL)

rule.label: No placebo
